reviewer: independent architecture agent; source reading plus CPU test doubles only

protocol_findings.memory: 2N actual child exits before parent GPU import
protocol_findings.ordering: N*ceil(5/N) complete cyclic position balance, frozen before measurement
protocol_findings.timing: 100 warmup;100 synchronized forwards/round/model/size; pooled P50/P95 and paired-round ratios; sample CV<=.05
protocol_findings.memory_windows: allocated/reserved plus baseline/increments and reset availability; whole-process peak labelled when no reset API
protocol_findings.failure: Deferred exit3 never emits complete success; invalid post-measurement samples/counts retained; timeout or unknown code never adopted

limitations: CPU approval does not prove actual GPU speed or idle availability; real hardware measurements remain required.
Baseline self-ratio CV0 is tautological, not a stability witness.
Known CPU console exception is limited to registered PID birth/exe, command/source hashes and a read-only CPU-status GET; all other Python/pureC/unknown entries refuse.
Source contains no hardcoded live PIDs; process identity registries are local artifacts and should not be published with scientific results.
